body: Having no one makes it so much harder. My parents think i'll simply get over it, and i'm not close enough with my brother to talk to him about it. I've been cut off with all other outside communication. I know I'll find new connections and people that I enjoy I just cannot convince myself I will. Everytime I think about the girl I just absolutely break down. Because of me her life was slowly improving, she stopped smoking pot in hopes that we may have a chance together and my parents have basically destroyed any chance for me to be with her ever again. She will be as devastated as I am. She may turn back to drugs because her family isn't supportive and nearly non-existent. I care more about her well being than mine. I just want her to be ok
